assays.assay_description: Thermal nociception in mice; radiant heat tail-flick (Ugo Basile / IITC unit) with latency expressed as %MPE. Conducted across cumulative s.c. doses, in WT and MOR-KO / KOR-KO mice, in both sexes, with antagonist pretreatments.

application_type.evidence: Mice were administered a 1 mg/kg s.c. dose of compound solution.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were moved to the testing room 30 min before the experiment to allow for acclimation.

setup_restrain.evidence: tail-flick measurement was taken using thermal stimulation via IR on a Ugo Basile unit (animal held for tail exposure)

food_restriction.evidence: Food provided ad libitum in home cage; not accessible during the short tail-flick test.

water_restriction.evidence: Water ad libitum in home cage; not accessible during test.

time_to_assay.evidence: Thirty minutes post injection, the tail-flick measurement was taken

sample_size.evidence: ED50 value for U50,488 was determined using four separate groups of naive mice (5 animals for each dose)

outcomes.summary: Oxa-noribogaine and epi-oxa-noribogaine induced potent, KOR-dependent antinociception comparable to U50,488 in both male and female mice. Analgesia was largely abolished in KOR-KO mice, with smaller shifts in MOR-KO mice.
outcomes.statistics: ED50(oxa-noriboga) = 3.0 mg/kg vs U50,488 = 2.2 mg/kg; KOR-KO vs WT P<0.0001; ED50(WT) = 2.3 mg/kg vs ED50(KOR-KO) = 17.7 mg/kg
outcomes.evidence: Oxa-noribogaine induced potent antinociceptive effects in male mice in the tail-flick assay... analgesic potency and efficacy of oxa-noribogaine is comparable between male and female mice and primarily driven by KOR activation

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Ugo Basile / IITC analgesia meter measures latency only

D3_recording_days.evidence: Cumulative dosing on single test day

D4_baseline.evidence: The body weight of each mouse and base tail-flick value were recorded.

assays.assay_description: 60-min locomotor activity in Plexiglas arena (27.31 × 27.31 × 20.32 cm, Med Associates ENV-510) with IR beam tracking. Used to assess sedation in mice across ED50/ED80/>ED95 doses, with and without aticaprant pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: Mice were administered an ED50, ED80 or >ED95 doses of test compound

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were transferred to the testing room 30 min before the experiment to allow for acclimation.

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to ambulate freely for 60 minutes

food_restriction.evidence: Food ad libitum in home cage; not present in OFT arena

water_restriction.evidence: Water ad libitum in home cage; not present in OFT arena

time_to_assay.evidence: After injection, mice were returned to the home cage and allowed to rest for 30 min

outcomes.summary: At ED80 dose (5.4 mg/kg), oxa-noribogaine did not induce sedation in male or female mice (locomotion comparable to vehicle). In stark contrast, epi-oxa-noribogaine (5.2 mg/kg) induced KOR-driven sedation, reversed by aticaprant pretreatment.
outcomes.statistics: epi-oxa-noribogaine (5.2 mg/kg, P <0.0001); aticaprant pretreatment P <0.0001
outcomes.evidence: oxa-noribogaine did not induce sedation in either male or female mice... epi-oxa induced a strong sedative effect at an equianalgesic dose, completely reversed by KOR antagonist aticaprant

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: two-way ANOVA with Šidák's multiple comparison test for post hoc comparison to analyze locomotion across time bins

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Med Associates Activity Monitor (IR beam-break, position only)

E1_environment_type.evidence: clear Plexiglas arena (27.31 × 27.31 × 20.32 cm, Med Associates ENV-510)

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was then gently placed in the center of the arena

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to ambulate freely for 60 minutes

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline recording in OFT

assays.assay_description: 6-min FST in plexiglass cylinder (40 cm tall, 22 cm diameter, water at 23.8–25.0 °C); immobility scored in the last 4 min using Noldus software. Male mice tested with saline, imipramine (positive control), and oxa-noribogaine.

application_type.evidence: oxa-noribogaine ED80 (5.4 mg/kg) or >ED95 10 mg/kg dose s.c.

setup_habituation.evidence: mice were weighed and transferred to the testing room 30 min prior to experimentation; mice were handled for ~5 min

setup_restrain.evidence: each subject mouse was gently placed into cylinder filled with water (FST cylinder = restraint per rubric)

food_restriction.evidence: No food in cylinder during test

water_restriction.evidence: No drinkable water/food in test apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 min after receiving oxa-noribogaine injection, each subject mouse was gently placed into cylinder

outcomes.summary: Oxa-noribogaine showed no acute pro-depressive-like effects in male mice at highly analgesic doses. Imipramine reduced immobility as a positive control.
outcomes.evidence: Oxa-noribogaine demonstrated no acute depressive-like effects in male mice at highly analgesic doses

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only the last 4 min of the 6 min test were analyzed for total immobility time

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility is not ethological per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Noldus FST scoring software (position/immobility detection, not behavioural classifier)

E1_environment_type.evidence: plexiglass cylinder (40 cm tall, diameter 22 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: Each subject mouse was gently placed into cylinder

D2_session_duration.evidence: Mice were allowed to swim for 6 min

assays.assay_description: Three-chamber CPP apparatus (two 16.8 × 12.7 × 12.7 cm conditioning chambers differing in color and flooring + middle chamber). 20-min pretest, three 2-day conditioning cycles (30-min sessions), 15-min test. Conducted in male and female mice with cocaine, morphine, oxa-noribogaine, and epi-oxa-noribogaine.

application_type.evidence: oxa-noribogaine (10 or 40 mg/kg, i.p.)... cocaine (10 mg/kg, i.p.), morphine (20 mg/kg, i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were acclimated to the room for three days before the pretest phase.

setup_restrain.evidence: the animal had free access to the chamber for 20 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food in CPP chambers during test

water_restriction.evidence: No water in CPP chambers during test

time_to_assay.evidence: Conditioning on days 1, 3, 5; testing on the seventh day (≈48 h after last conditioning dose)

outcomes.summary: Oxa-noribogaine produced no CPP or CPA in either male or female mice at supra-analgesic doses, in contrast to cocaine and morphine which produced significant CPP.
outcomes.statistics: Oxa-noribogaine: P = 0.4531 (males), P = 0.5994 (females); cocaine 10 mg/kg: P = 0.0029, 0.0013; morphine 20 mg/kg: P = 0.0010, 0.0153
outcomes.evidence: Male and female mice do not develop a conditioned place preference or aversion (CPP/CPA) after administration of oxa-noribogaine (P=0.4531, P=0.5994, respectively), in contrast to cocaine and morphine

B1_num_measures.evidence: A CPP score was calculated as the difference in time spent in the drug-paired minus the vehicle paired compartment

B6_cognitive.evidence: Conditioned place preference requires learned association

E1_environment_type.evidence: three-chamber apparatus with two equal sized chambers

E6_spatial.evidence: three-chamber apparatus with two equal sized chambers separated by a middle chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: 20-min pretest + 15-min test (both recorded) plus conditioning sessions

D2_session_duration.evidence: free access to the chamber for 20 min (pretest); 15 min (test)

D3_recording_days.evidence: Pretest day + test on day 7; conditioning days between

D4_baseline.evidence: For determination of pre-conditioning baseline preferences, mice were placed in the middle chamber

D5_followup.evidence: Test on day 7, ~48 h after last drug administration

assays.assay_description: Operant IV self-administration in male Fisher F-344 rats (FR1:TO20s; 2-h sessions; active vs inactive lever). Includes acquisition, dose-effect curves (morphine 10/20/40 µg/inf; heroin 4.5 µg/inf; fentanyl 0.625 µg/inf), extinction, and cue-induced reinstatement. Tested with vehicle, noribogaine (40 mg/kg, i.p.), oxa-noribogaine (3, 10, 30, 40 mg/kg, i.p.), and epi-oxa-noribogaine.

application_type.evidence: rats were administered oxa-noribogaine in an ascending dose manner (3, 10 or 30 mg/kg, i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper does not specifically describe pre-test apparatus habituation beyond lever training.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats freely moved in operant chambers with tethered swivel

food_restriction.evidence: Food access was restricted in the home cage, such that rats were maintained at 90% of their normal body weight until responding was engendered

water_restriction.evidence: Water ad libitum in home cage; not in operant chamber

time_to_assay.evidence: administered 30 min prior to the beginning of the session

sample_size.evidence: all study groups n=7 (morphine 40 mg/kg cohort); n=9 (fentanyl); 10 µg/inf, n=8; 20 µg/inf, n=10; 40 µg/inf, n=8; heroin n=11; reinstatement vehicle n=5, oxa n=8

outcomes.summary: Oxa-noribogaine (40 mg/kg, i.p.) produced more profound and longer-lasting suppression of morphine intake than noribogaine (significant for 7 days). Dose-dependent suppression of morphine, heroin, and fentanyl SA was observed both acutely and post-acutely (up to 5–7 days). Cue-induced reinstatement of fentanyl and morphine seeking was reduced by ~60% by oxa-noribogaine (10 mg/kg).
outcomes.statistics: Oxa vs noribogaine morphine SA: P=0.0001; food 40 mg/kg P<0.0001; morphine 20 µg/inf: 3 mg/kg P=0.0419, 10 mg/kg P<0.0001 (Day 1); Day 5: 3 mg/kg P=0.0243, 10 mg/kg P=0.0044; heroin session 8 (10 mg/kg) P=0.0012, session 15 (30 mg/kg) P<0.0001; reinstatement fentanyl P=0.0141, morphine P=0.042
outcomes.evidence: One injection of oxa-noribogaine (40 mg/kg) results in statistically significant suppression of morphine intake for 7 days... a single dose of oxa-noribogaine reduced the intake of fentanyl for at least five days... oxa-noribogaine (10 mg/kg, i.p.) reduces cue-induced fentanyl (P=0.0141) and morphine (P=0.042) seeking

B1_num_measures.evidence: Active lever responses, inactive lever responses, infusions earned

B6_cognitive.evidence: Operant self-administration with learned cue associations, extinction, and reinstatement

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Med Associates operant software records lever presses

E6_spatial.evidence: Single chamber with levers and food chute

E8_food_water.evidence: Drug infusion delivered, no food/water in drug SA sessions

D1_continuity.evidence: daily 2-h self-administration sessions over many days

D2_session_duration.evidence: The self-administration session continued for 2 h or until 70 infusions were delivered

D3_recording_days.evidence: minimum of two weeks of self-administration... responding assessed for seven days following each dose, plus extinction and reinstatement

D4_baseline.evidence: After stable responding was established, rats were administered vehicle 30 min prior to the subsequent experimental session

D5_followup.evidence: Responding was assessed for seven days following each dose

assays.assay_description: Operant FR1 lever-pressing for 45-mg food pellets in male rats (2-h sessions, up to 20 pellets, TO 6 min) to control for non-specific motor/sedation effects of oxa-noribogaine, epi-oxa-noribogaine, and noribogaine.

application_type.evidence: oxa-noribogaine (10 and 40 mg/kg, i.p.)... noribogaine (10 and 40 mg/kg, i.p.) or vehicle administered intraperitoneal

setup_habituation.evidence: Lever training described; no separate apparatus habituation explicitly stated

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats freely moved in operant chamber

food_restriction.evidence: food access was restricted such that rats were maintained at 90% of their normal body weight until responding stabilized

water_restriction.evidence: Water ad libitum in home cage; not present in operant chamber during test

time_to_assay.evidence: administered intraperitoneal 15 min prior to the initiation of the session

outcomes.summary: Food-maintained responding was suppressed acutely by 40 mg/kg oxa-noribogaine and noribogaine on day 1 but returned to baseline by day 2–3. 10 mg/kg oxa-noribogaine had only a marginal, non-significant effect on food intake.
outcomes.statistics: 40 mg/kg vs vehicle P<0.0001 on day 1
outcomes.evidence: Food operant intake (natural reward) is reduced following administration of 40 mg/kg but not 10 mg/kg (P<0.0001). The moderate dose (10 mg/kg) has a marginal effect on food intake

B1_num_measures.evidence: Active and inactive lever responding, pellets earned

B6_cognitive.evidence: Operant lever pressing under FR1 schedule (learned)

E8_food_water.evidence: Food pellets delivered into food chute during session

D2_session_duration.evidence: sessions lasting 2 h or until a maximum of 20 pellets was delivered

D3_recording_days.evidence: Stable responding established over many sessions; multiple test doses across days

D4_baseline.evidence: Once responding stabilized... rats were administered vehicle prior to drug test

D5_followup.evidence: Food responding monitored on days following drug administration

assays.assay_description: Electronic Von Frey (BIO-EVF5) measurement of paw withdrawal threshold (PWT) in male rats with chronic morphine pellet-induced hyperalgesia. Baseline, then 8 h, 24 h, and 168 h after pellet removal/oxa-noribogaine (30 mg/kg, i.p.) treatment.

application_type.evidence: rats were administered either vehicle... or oxa-noribogaine solution (30 mg/kg; I.P.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were placed in a modular holder cage on a wire mesh elevated stand and allowed to acclimate for 5 min prior to assessment

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats placed in modular holder cage (containment cage, not body restraint)

food_restriction.evidence: Food ad libitum in home cage; not in test cage during brief assessment

water_restriction.evidence: Water ad libitum in home cage; not in test cage

time_to_assay.evidence: Paw withdrawal thresholds were recorded for each group in selected time intervals: 8 h, 24 h and 168 h post-implant removal (6, 22 and 166 h post oxa-noribogaine treatment respectively)

outcomes.summary: Chronic morphine pellet implantation produced robust mechanical hyperalgesia (reduced PWT) persisting at least 7 days. A single dose of oxa-noribogaine (30 mg/kg, i.p.) completely reversed OIH at 6 h and produced sustained attenuation at 1 week.
outcomes.statistics: Placebo-Veh vs Morphine-Veh: 8 h P=0.004, 24 h P=0.0258, 168 h P=0.0157; Morphine-Veh vs Morphine-Oxa: 8 h P=0.0164; Placebo-Oxa vs Morphine-Veh: 8 h P=0.0127, 24 h P=0.0305, 168 h P=0.0003
outcomes.evidence: One dose of oxa-noribogaine (30 mg/kg, i.p.) induced a complete reversal of the OIH phenotype 6 h post oxa-noribogaine administration and attenuation one week later

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Electronic Von Frey records force only

E1_environment_type.evidence: modular holder cage on a wire mesh elevated stand

D1_continuity.evidence: Baseline + 8 h, 24 h, and 168 h post-implant removal recordings

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5 min acclimation plus brief PWT measurements

D3_recording_days.evidence: Baseline + ~3 post-removal timepoints (8 h, 24 h, 168 h)

D4_baseline.evidence: Prior to pellet implantation, baseline measurements of paw withdrawal threshold (PWT) using Von Frey (VF) assay were taken

judge_notes: Merged Qwen's separate 'Cue-induced reinstatement' phases into the IV Self-Administration assay per rubric (acquisition + extinction + reinstatement = 1 operant SA assay).

Collapsed all morphine, heroin, and fentanyl SA experiments into a single 'Intravenous Drug Self-Administration' assay since the apparatus, protocol, and measured outcomes are identical and only the reinforcer/drug arm differs.
Dropped GPT-OSS entries (it produced no assays). Used Qwen + GLM as primary sources, with checks against the paper text.
Sex set to 'both' because mice were both sexes; rats in SA/OIH were male-only — noted in outcomes.
DOI not stated in extracted markdown; set to null.

Day/night flip set to 'no' based on explicit mouse light cycle (lights on 7:00–19:00, testing in light cycle). Rats had lights on at 18:00 with testing in dark phase, but the housing_conditions block is study-level and the mouse condition is explicit and non-flipped; flagged in evidence.
